I built Mural to practise the conversations I actually wanted to have. It’s an open-source voice-only language companion that starts with hello, follows your pace, and helps useful words stick. - William Imoh

Request accessView on GitHub

Currently supports Norwegian, Spanish, English & French

Just start talking.

Speak freely. Mural replies in the language you’re learning, with meanings whenever you need a hand.

Find your own pace.

Follow a theme or see where the conversation goes. Mural adapts and offers gentle corrections along the way.

Take the words with you.

Useful words return in conversation. Your vocabulary and saved conversations stay on your iPhone.
